summary: Build QA reports, review systems, and accreditation evidence for higher education. Train with practical tools and expert-led exercises.
lede: Higher education quality assurance helps professionals responsible for academic quality oversight review programmes and turn evidence into practical improvement actions. The course develops skills in mapping programme evidence, moderating assessments against learning outcomes, preparing self-evaluation reports and quality dashboards, and using root cause analysis to prioritise follow-up actions for academic review and governance.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals responsible for academic quality oversight, accreditation evidence, and institutional enhancement in higher education. Quality Assurance Managers overseeing institutional review cycles and action plans. Academic Quality Officers maintaining programme approval and monitoring evidence. Accreditation Coordinators preparing self-evaluation reports and audit packs. Programme Review Leads managing curriculum review and validation documentation. Institutional Effectiveness Analysts tracking QA indicators and improvement trends. Registry Managers supporting assessment records, moderation logs, and governance files. Faculty Quality Leads aligning departmental practice with institutional QA policy. External Liaison Officers coordinating evidence requests for review panels. Assessment and Standards Officers checking moderation, grading, and academic integrity evidence. Senior Academic Administrators reporting QA performance to leadership and governing bodies.
modules: Root Cause Analysis for Academic Issues
prerequisites: Recommended prerequisites: working knowledge of higher education administration, programme management, assessment processes, or academic governance. Prior experience with internal review, accreditation support, or quality documentation is helpful. No coding is required, but you should be comfortable working with spreadsheets, policy documents, review templates, and institutional reports. Advanced concepts will be taught at an operational level, with practical application focused on QA evidence, standards mapping, review cycles, and reporting workflows.
